import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import cross_val_score, StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline
from sklearn.impute import SimpleImputer
from sklearn.preprocessing import FunctionTransformer
tr=pd.read_csv('train.csv'); X=tr.drop(columns='outcome'); y=tr.outcome
cols=['glucose','blood_pressure','skin_thickness','insulin','bmi']
def zero_to_nan(d):
    d=d.copy(); d[cols]=d[cols].replace(0,np.nan); return d
cv=StratifiedKFold(5,shuffle=True,random_state=0)
rf=lambda: RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=300,random_state=0)
raw=make_pipeline(rf())
imp=make_pipeline(FunctionTransformer(zero_to_nan),SimpleImputer(strategy='median'),rf())
print('raw zeros  CV acc:', cross_val_score(raw,X,y,cv=cv).mean().round(4))
print('zero->NaN+median CV acc:', cross_val_score(imp,X,y,cv=cv).mean().round(4))
"

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg'); import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline
from sklearn.impute import SimpleImputer
from sklearn.preprocessing import FunctionTransformer
from sklearn.model_selection import cross_val_score, RepeatedStratifiedKFold
df=pd.read_csv('data.csv').drop_duplicates().reset_index(drop=True)
X=df.drop(columns='outcome'); y=df.outcome
cols=['glucose','blood_pressure','skin_thickness','insulin','bmi']
def zero_to_nan(d):
    d=d.copy(); d[cols]=d[cols].replace(0,np.nan); return d
model=make_pipeline(FunctionTransformer(zero_to_nan),SimpleImputer(strategy='median'),RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=300,random_state=0))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(6,4)); imp.plot.barh(ax=ax); ax.set_title('Random forest feature importance (outcome)'); ax.set_xlabel('importance')

print(imp.round(3).to_dict())

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, json
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline
from sklearn.impute import SimpleImputer
from sklearn.preprocessing import FunctionTransformer
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
tr=pd.read_csv('train.csv'); te=pd.read_csv('test.csv'); h=pd.read_csv('holdout_features.csv')
cols=['glucose','blood_pressure','skin_thickness','insulin','bmi']
def zero_to_nan(d):
    d=d.copy(); d[cols]=d[cols].replace(0,np.nan); return d
model=make_pipeline(FunctionTransformer(zero_to_nan),SimpleImputer(strategy='median'),RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=300,random_state=0))
model.fit(tr.drop(columns='outcome'),tr.outcome)
acc=float(accuracy_score(te.outcome,model.predict(te.drop(columns='outcome'))))
report={'test_accuracy':round(acc,4),'model':'RandomForestClassifier (n_estimators=300, random_state=0) with zero-as-missing median imputation',
 'notes':'Dropped 57 exact duplicate rows (864 remain) and split 80/20 stratified (random_state=42). Glucose, blood pressure, skin thickness, insulin and BMI zeros were treated as missing and median-imputed; repeated 5x5 CV on all data gave 0.863 +/- 0.022, so the single test score is at the high end of the expected range.'}
json.dump(report,open('report.json','w'),indent=2)
pred=model.predict(h[tr.drop(columns='outcome').columns])
pd.DataFrame({'prediction':pred.astype(int)}).to_csv('predictions.csv',index=False)
print(report); print(pd.Series(pred).value_counts().to_dict())
"
